messages:
rachael.docs: Quick report from supportaa new user hit 401s and timeouts after copy/pasting our quickstart. The README uses REDWOOD_TOKEN in some places and REDWOOD_API_KEY in others. Also the curl example has no --max-time or retry guidance.

omar.sdk: Yikes. We changed the canonical env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY months ago but I guess some examples weren't updated. Can you paste the curl snippet?

rachael.docs: It was this:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

rachael.docs: Without timeout/retry the user's CI hung on a transient network blip.

omar.sdk: We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, add a curl example with timeout and retry (curl --retry/--retry-delay/--max-time), and call out the SDK clients that handle retries automatically.

devsec: Also saw a sample-app seed file in sample-apps/demo that had a literal placeholder_API_KEY="replace-me" committed. We've had accidental token commits before; can we add a .env.example, and a git-secrets pre-commit hook snippet in CONTRIBUTING?

rachael.docs: Agreed. Plan: 1) update all docs to REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) add a robust curl example, 3) replace seeds/credentials with .env.example and add a "do not commit keys" blurb, 4) add link to git-secrets setup. I'll open a PR.

omar.sdk: For the curl example, suggest this copy-paste ready variant:```bash
# simple request with retries and max time
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"<your_api_key>\"

curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
  --max-time 10 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2
```

omar.sdk: And add a one-liner: "Prefer official SDKs (Node/Python/Go) for production; they implement retry, backoff, and sensible timeouts."

devsec: I'll draft a git-secrets rule and a short pre-commit snippet for the docs PR so maintainers can opt-in quickly. Also propose adding a CI lint that greps for common placeholder tokens.

rachael.docs: PR #5321 opened: updates env var names, adds curl retries/timeouts, swaps seeds/dev.env for .env.example, and adds contributing note + git-secrets snippet. Preview: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-5321

ci-bot: docs-preview: build 9456 passed 607 warnings (links).

omar.sdk: I'll add a small note in the SDK changelog and a backport to the v1.x docs after merge.

devsec: Also added issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/509 to track a global grep for REDWOOD_TOKEN occurrences.

rachael.docs: Thanks team. Follow-up: let's add a tiny "common gotchas" section to the quickstart listing env var names, curl flags, and where to find client examples.

omar.sdk: SGTM, thanks for catching this early.
